supporting_observations.claim: User ivy.chen used PowerShell to compress a directory from the file server (\\FILE-NWD-01\Shared\Clients) into a local zip file (C:\Users\ivy.chen\AppData\Local\Temp\c.zip).
User ivy.chen accessed a file-sharing site quickshare-drop.net via Chrome.
A large outbound transfer of approximately 51 MB was sent from WS-ICHEN-01 to quickshare-drop.net via the proxy.
The outbound transfer of 51 MB aligns with the alerted activity (tens of MB) and the previous local archival of server data into a zip file.

unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect VPN software is present and executed on WS-ICHEN-01 (T039-00190), despite the environment context stating there is no VPN.
Zscaler ZSATunnel is present and executed on WS-ICHEN-01 (T039-00264).
